title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證~Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification
focus: 辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力~Distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer
summary: 本課以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為主線，從岩楔荷重與岩栓方向與鋼材屈服與有效面積建立系統邊界，再把自由段伸長與系統柔度、持載位移與時間效應連到試驗代表性與補強決策。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer. It begins with Wedge weight and bolt direction and Steel yielding and effective area, links Free-length extension and system compliance and Hold movement and time effects, and ends with Representativeness and reinforcement decisions. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向~Wedge weight and bolt direction
units.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向~Wedge weight and bolt direction
units.mechanism: 岩栓能否穩住岩楔取決於節理幾何、摩擦以及力的方向，而非單看根數。垂直分量必須平衡重力，水平分量可能改變節理正向力；將所有岩栓當成平均分擔會忽略偏心與先後受力，需先畫出可移動岩塊的自由體圖。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖；若出現岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Wedge restraint depends on joint geometry, friction and bolt orientation rather than count alone. Vertical components balance gravity while horizontal components can modify joint normal force. Equal sharing ignores eccentricity and sequential engagement, so first isolate the movable block in a free-body diagram. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. If a bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. units.failure: 岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向~Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
units.practice: 將將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 鋼材屈服與有效面積~Steel yielding and effective area
units.title: 鋼材屈服與有效面積~Steel yielding and effective area
units.mechanism: 鋼材承載面積可能由螺紋根部或腐蝕局部截面控制，不一定等於公稱直徑。拉拔系統也包含接頭和夾具，若先發生局部滑移，量得曲線便不是純鋼材拉伸；應把鋼材屈服與界面拔出分開設定模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長；若出現以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The thread root or a locally corroded section may control steel area rather than nominal diameter. Connections and grips also belong to the pull system; early slip produces a response unlike pure steel tension. Model steel yielding separately from interface pullout and identify which limit is being tested. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading. If using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.anchor: 漿體黏結與有效長度~Grout bond and effective length
units.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度~Grout bond and effective length
units.mechanism: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。均勻黏結公式只能作平均量級，裂隙、灌漿空洞與孔壁擾動會減少有效長度；提高漿體抗壓也不一定改善岩漿界面的剪力傳遞。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像；若出現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections. A uniform-bond formula provides an average scale only. Fractures, grout voids and disturbed bore walls reduce effective length, while greater grout compression strength need not improve rock-grout shear transfer. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 托盤承壓與岩面凹凸~Plate bearing and rock roughness
units.title: 托盤承壓與岩面凹凸~Plate bearing and rock roughness
units.mechanism: 托盤把軸力傳給局部岩面，實際接觸面積受凹凸、薄片和墊層影響。整片鋼板面積不等於受壓面積，局部壓碎可使預力流失而鋼栓仍完好；托盤轉角與岩面裂紋因此是傳力判讀的重要證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋；若出現托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A plate transfers axial force to local rock contact controlled by roughness, flakes and bedding. Gross plate area is not necessarily bearing area. Local crushing can lose preload while the bolt remains intact, making plate rotation and surrounding cracks important transfer evidence. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock. If crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 自由段伸長與系統柔度~Free-length extension and system compliance
units.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度~Free-length extension and system compliance
units.mechanism: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。用全長代入純鋼伸長公式會錯把黏結段當成自由段；比較載卸曲線可辨認可回復彈性與不可回復滑移，但仍需要獨立基準才能分離支承移動。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動；若出現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. Full-length elastic calculation wrongly treats bonded length as free. Loading-unloading response distinguishes recoverable extension from slip, but independent references are still needed to separate support movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 反力位置與局部約束~Reaction location and local restraint
units.title: 反力位置與局部約束~Reaction location and local restraint
units.mechanism: 拉拔反力若直接壓在受測錨固區附近，會提高局部圍壓並改變岩體破壞路徑。測試看似只是向外拉，實際同時向內壓縮周邊岩面；反力支點尺寸與間距必須記錄，才可知道結果代表何種約束條件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區；若出現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Reaction close to the anchorage increases confinement and alters rock failure paths. Pulling outward simultaneously compresses nearby ground inward. Record reaction footprint and spacing so the result can be interpreted under its actual restraint rather than as an unconstrained rock capacity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為~The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
units.practice: 將記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 持載位移與時間效應~Hold movement and time effects
units.title: 持載位移與時間效應~Hold movement and time effects
units.mechanism: 恆定荷重下位移增加可能來自黏結蠕變，也可能是油壓漂移或支承沉陷。必須同時記錄實際荷重，才能區分持載滑移與荷重仍在增加；單一時間點的位移不能代表速率，更不能直接外推長期壽命。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準；若出現油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Movement under constant load can reflect bond creep, pressure drift or support settlement. Record actual force simultaneously to distinguish hold slip from continued loading. One displacement point establishes neither a rate nor a reliable extrapolation of long-term service behaviour. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold. If a slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 荷重校正與不確定度~Load calibration and uncertainty
units.title: 荷重校正與不確定度~Load calibration and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 壓力乘活塞面積只是理想液壓力，密封摩擦、有效面積與回程方向會造成偏差。荷重元可提供獨立比較，但也需校正與對中；不確定度應和試體離散分開報告，避免把設備偏差歸因於地質變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向；若出現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Pressure times piston area gives ideal hydraulic force; seal friction, effective area and direction introduce bias. A load cell offers independent comparison but also needs calibration and alignment. Separate instrumental uncertainty from specimen variability instead of attributing equipment bias to geology. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. If ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面~Corrosion loss and local weak sections
units.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面~Corrosion loss and local weak sections
units.mechanism: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。直徑減少對面積有平方影響，局部坑蝕又會加劇應力集中；用平均重量損失推估剩餘承載，需要確認最小截面及腐蝕分布是否已被量到。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化；若出現局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. Diameter loss changes area quadratically, and pits add stress concentration. Inferring capacity from mean mass loss requires evidence that the minimum section and corrosion distribution have actually been characterized. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time. If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent. units.anchor: 試驗代表性與補強決策~Representativeness and reinforcement decisions
units.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策~Representativeness and reinforcement decisions
units.mechanism: 拉拔試點通常只覆蓋少量岩栓，結果的適用範圍由地質、施工批次及錨固型式決定。可接近位置可能比濕區或破碎區容易施工，取樣偏差會留下未驗證族群；交接須讓每個結果能追溯到同類岩栓，而不是以全區平均替代分區判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表；若出現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Pull tests sample few bolts, with applicability governed by geology, batches and anchorage type. Accessible positions may be easier to install than wet or fractured areas, leaving unverified populations. Trace each result to comparable bolts instead of substituting a global mean for zoned interpretation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each；再獨立檢查鋼材屈服與有效面積：Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN。假想岩楔由 4 增為 5 m3，單位重 26 kN/m3 不變，重量由 104 增為 130 kN；兩支垂直岩栓只有在理想對稱下才各分擔 65 kN。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 將用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Wedge weight and bolt direction: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. Independently check Steel yielding and effective area: Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN. Increasing assumed wedge volume from 4 to 5 m3 at 26 kN/m3 raises weight from 104 to 130 kN; two vertical bolts share 65 kN each only under ideal symmetry. The two results are not a complete design because a single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Use compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
